nature: Current navigation and validation projection only. Not an operational register; confers no authority; PPV Potential throughout.

B1.name: Decision clarity
B1.meaning: The Steward can see current state, objective and next valid action without reconstruction.
B1.evidence: Cold-start walkthrough receipt; priority projection freshness stamp.
B1.realisation: A cold-start user reaches the correct next action from Home in under five clicks, verified by replay receipt.

B2.name: Delivery speed
B2.meaning: New Processes and Offerings move from idea to governed candidate without manual re-architecture.
B2.evidence: Candidate packet completeness check against the registry template; routing trace through the nine verbs.
B2.realisation: A complete candidate packet is produced through the start surface with all required fields and a verb-routing trace, no manual reconstruction.

B3.name: Assurance confidence
B3.meaning: Claims about state are evidence-bound; validation gates precede action.
B3.evidence: Test-matrix results filed with SHA-256 receipts; independent re-verification entries.
B3.realisation: All applicable automated assertions pass and are filed; disputed claims recorded as conflicts, not accepted.

B4.name: Asset compounding
B4.meaning: Qualified outcomes convert into reusable Patterns, Methods and Canonical objects instead of one-off narratives.
B4.evidence: Asset-qualification conditions recorded per candidate; Steward qualification decision reference.
B4.realisation: An outcome is only labelled an Asset after meeting written qualification conditions under Steward authority; until then it is recorded as candidate evidence.

B5.name: Governance integrity
B5.meaning: Authority boundaries, STOP/HOLD states and PPV discipline remain visible and enforced on every route.
B5.evidence: Authority and HOLD blocks rendered on every surface; registry authority fields; held-item register.
B5.realisation: No surface implies an unauthorised mutation; every held action is labelled HOLD with the holding authority named.
